items: Automatic video sync: tempo detection from the phone also finds the beats and beat 1 in the video and turns on Ikut video, so the metronome plays along when you press play
App log records when the metronome follows the video and the average metronome–video difference every 30 seconds
More precise BPM when the AI misses a beat or two
Tempo detection from the phone: the video is played automatically after permission is given (it was paused, so only silence was heard) and paused again afterwards if it was paused before
Message to open the song's video first (or use the microphone) when choosing Langsung dari HP
App log records the video state while listening and warns when the phone blocks capturing video sound
AI tempo detection with the Beat This! model, running offline on the phone; falls back to the old method
Listen straight from the phone (Android 10+): reads the sound of the video playing in the app instead of the microphone
App log (⋮ → Log aplikasi): events, errors, crashes and AI tempo details; stored on the phone only, share with ⤴ Bagikan
AMOLED theme: pure black background, brighter chords and numbers, bolder lyrics. Switch via ⋮ → Tema
Interactive guide on the real buttons for first-time users; tap the highlighted button to try it. Replay via ⋮ → Panduan
After an update only a short "Diperbarui ke vX" card is shown
Features that can still be inaccurate are marked EKSPERIMENTAL (metronome, sync to video, modulation suggestions); listed in ⋮ → Tentang
Play in key: the Do = … button now moves the chords to the key you pick; the numbers stay the same. The original key is marked, and "Kunci asli salah? Ubah" fixes a wrongly detected original key
Songs whose key was changed with the old Do button are converted: the detected key becomes the original key and your chosen key becomes the playing key
In-app updates: the app checks GitHub for new versions (once a day or via ⋮ → Cek update), downloads the APK and opens the installer
⋮ menu: Cek update, Apa yang baru (this history) and Tentang
The key written on the page is checked against the chords (e.g. PsalmNote says Do = F while the chords are in A)
Saved songs with such a wrong key are corrected automatically when opened
Worship lists per date (Daftar ibadah) with their own key per list, play in order with ‹ ›
Metronome follows the YouTube video after you tap the beat once
Export / import the whole collection to one file
Metronome with count-in voice, beat patterns, sounds and a song sequencer with section cues
Chord bridges and notes per line, song notes
"Key: X" in the middle of a song is read as a modulation
YouTube video for each song, found automatically
Modulation markers, suggestions and manual modulation
M/m marks in number notation (D(2M), Fm(4m))
The app no longer draws under the status bar and navigation buttons (Android 15)
JRChord key buttons are no longer read as chords; "Do = X" is shown once
First release: search chords by title or lyrics (JRChord & PsalmNote first), number notation, transpose, offline collection, auto-scroll
